# Third-party Python code bundled into the browser engine

`kvkk_pii/` is [kvkk-pii](https://pypi.org/project/kvkk-pii/) 0.2.0 by Aleonis, MIT licence, copied unchanged
from the PyPI wheel. The demo runs its default regex layer as the **vanilla baseline** model, so the improvement
from Katip's own rules and models can be shown side by side. Its optional NER/GLiNER layers are not used.
